main_measure.name: OLS slope of 3-bar excess forward return on rise5 forecast (grid cases with forecast > 0)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2.0 and supporting check passes; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2.0

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2.0 and the forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Grid cases are bars at positions 0, 3, 6, ... of each window with forecast > 0 and a 3-bar forward return inside the window; the drift is the coin's mean 3-bar return on that grid over all its windows; the slope is an OLS regression with intercept, t = slope / its standard error.
